script:
#!/bin/bash
set -u
TMP=/tmp/_vault_new.js
rm -f "$TMP"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/fc4e980dbf95136903f47d5814c8f340ed4d84a0/vault-data.js' -o "$TMP" || curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw' -H 'User-Agent: xinmo-vps-sync' 'https://api.github.com/repos/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/contents/vault-data.js?ref=fc4e980dbf95136903f47d5814c8f340ed4d84a0' -o "$TMP" || { echo '下载失败'; exit 1; }
GOT_SHA=$(sha256sum "$TMP" | awk '{print $1}')
if [ "$GOT_SHA" != '18edd073bcb44fe64a1eb155cfa451f566355b9bd25a5db6bdf42b2696f03102' ]; then echo "SHA256 不匹配: got=$GOT_SHA expect=18edd073bcb44fe64a1eb155cfa451f566355b9bd25a5db6bdf42b2696f03102"; exit 2; fi
grep -q 'PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256' "$TMP" || { echo '结构异常（不是加密信封），未覆盖'; exit 3; }
grep -o '"generatedAt": "[^"]*"' "$TMP" | head -1
sudo install -m 644 -o root -g root "$TMP" /var/www/xinmo-site/vault-data.js
rm -f "$TMP"
ls -l --time-style=+%H:%M:%S /var/www/xinmo-site/vault-data.js
sha256sum /var/www/xinmo-site/vault-data.js
curl -fsS "https://xinmo.work/vault-data.js?t=$(date +%s)" | grep -o '"generatedAt": "[^"]*"' | head -1
